subject: Língua Portuguesa
description_pt: Utilizar, ao produzir o texto, recursos de coesão pronominal (pronomes anafóricos) e articuladores de relações de sentido (tempo, causa, oposição, conclusão, comparação), com nível adequado de informatividade.

components.description_pt: Aplicar pronomes anafóricos para estabelecer coesão pronominal em textos escritos
components.description_en: Apply anaphoric pronouns to establish pronominal cohesion in written texts
components.cc_component_description: Match pronouns to their antecedents in number, gender, and person

components.description_pt: Usar conectivos que expressam tempo, causa, contraste, conclusão e comparação em textos
components.description_en: Use connectives that express time, cause, contrast, conclusion, and comparison in texts
components.cc_component_description: Apply subordinating and coordinating connectives to clarify logical relationships between claims and evidence

components.description_pt: Manter nível apropriado de informatividade ao usar recursos coesivos na escrita
components.description_en: Maintain an appropriate level of informativeness when using cohesive resources in writing
components.cc_component_description: Clarify the relationship between claims and supporting reasons using cohesive devices

cc_matches.description: Link opinion and reasons using words, phrases, and clauses (e.g., consequently, specifically).

Use words, phrases, and clauses to link the major sections of the text, create cohesion, and clarify the relationships between claim(s) and reasons, between reasons and evidence, and between claim(s) and counterclaims.
